clue.text: One in fact's disheartened by the aspects

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other, as 'in' says here
losing its heart means the middle letters of fact are taken out, leaving its first and last letters

parts.note: the word fact with its S from the 's kept on the end
an ace is the one on a playing card or die

explanation.surface: A gloomy aside about facts being dispiriting from every angle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' strips the middle AC from FACT, leaving FT with the S after it; ACE goes in between to make the answer. 'by the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Facets are the separate sides or features of a subject, so they are its aspects.

clue.text: A sly one runs dances

parts.note: the fox is proverbially cunning
trots means runs at a gentle pace

explanation.surface: A cunning person gets away with a few dance steps.
explanation.definitionFit: The foxtrot is a ballroom dance, so the plural form names several such dances.

clue.text: South American doctor, one took article in Panamanian port

indicators.note: the doctor, one and article are placed inside the port's name

parts.note: Colon is a port city at the Caribbean end of the Panama Canal
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification
I is the Roman numeral for one
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A doctor in a Panama port picks up a newspaper article.
explanation.walkthrough: 'took' is only a link joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A Colombian is a native of Colombia, a country of South America, used here as a noun or adjective.

clue.text: Delay sentence on persistent offender

parts.note: doing time is serving a prison sentence
an old lag is slang for a habitual criminal

explanation.surface: A repeat criminal's prison term is postponed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sentence' is a prison term, not a line of words; 'old lag' is British slang for a habitual convict. 'on' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A time lag is the interval or delay between one event and another.

clue.text: See about gold coin being included in trains

indicators.note: the coin goes inside the other piece, as being included says
about tells us to turn the word see round to read the other way

parts.note: taken as written before it is turned
the ducat was a gold coin of old European trade

explanation.surface: A traveller looks at gold coins tucked away in railway carriages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns See round to EES, and the coin sits inside after its first letter; 'trains' is a verb meaning teaches, not railway stock.
explanation.definitionFit: To train someone is to teach or school them, the same as educating them.

clue.text: Release from slavery revolutionary man who will hold spellbound men for a short time

indicators.note: turning round like a revolution, the name is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: Sid is a man's name
to enthral is to hold someone spellbound
taken as written
T is the short form of time

explanation.surface: A revolutionary leader's speech holds the freed men spellbound for a moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' turns SID into DIS. 'who will' and 'for' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Disenthralment is the act of freeing someone from bondage, an older word for emancipation.

clue.text: Ruminant's feature found in the field?

definitions.text: Ruminant's feature found in the field?

parts.words: Ruminant's feature found in the field?
parts.note: read as the mouth part of a grazing beast, but it is a yellow wild flower of meadows

explanation.surface: A grazing animal's mouth is spotted out in the meadow.
explanation.definitionFit: The cowslip is a wild primula of grassland, so it is indeed found in the field.

clue.text: Carried drink from in France on the way up

parts.note: a tot is a small measure of spirits

indicators.note: in a down clue going up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: de is French for from

explanation.surface: Someone brings a drink back up from France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the way up' turns DE into ED below TOT.
explanation.definitionFit: To tote is to carry, so toted is a synonym of carried in the past tense.

clue.text: Mum put penny under border for little fellow

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece placed under another follows it

parts.note: mum as a call for silence is sh
a rim is an edge or border

explanation.surface: A mother puts a coin by the edge for her small child.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mum' is not a mother but 'keep quiet', SH. 'put' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrimp is a small creature, used informally of a tiny person.

clue.text: Change from one's normal eating habits?

definitions.text: Change from one's normal eating habits?

parts.words: Change from one's normal eating habits?
parts.note: seems to describe altering a diet, but habits are clothes, so it means swapping everyday wear for formal evening attire

explanation.surface: Someone thinks about changing their usual diet.
explanation.definitionFit: To dress for dinner is to put on formal clothes for the evening meal, changing from normal clothing.

clue.text: Woody tissue found in waxy lemonade!

indicators.note: found in shows the answer sits inside the run of letters that follows

explanation.surface: A bit of plant matter turns up in a glass of lemonade.
explanation.definitionFit: Xylem is the woody vascular tissue that carries water up through a plant.

clue.text: Came up with liquid perfume

parts.note: rose means came up, as the sun does
water is the commonest liquid

explanation.surface: Someone invents a new liquid scent.
explanation.definitionFit: Rosewater is a fragrant liquid distilled from rose petals and used as a scent.

clue.text: Another rum soul who was a twin

indicators.note: another version of these letters means they are rearranged

parts.note: rum means odd here, part of the surface

explanation.surface: One more odd person who turns out to be a twin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rum' means odd in the surface but its letters go into the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Romulus, legendary founder of Rome, was twin brother of Remus.

clue.text: It produced a blockage on Egypt's principal shipping route

definitions.text: It produced a blockage on Egypt's principal shipping route

parts.words: It produced a blockage on Egypt's principal shipping route
parts.note: sounds like a ship sunk in the Suez Canal, but means the barrier built across the great river

explanation.surface: A news report on something stopping traffic on Egypt's main waterway.
explanation.definitionFit: A dam across the river at Aswan blocks the flow of Egypt's ancient highway of boats.

clue.text: Antique that's no longer in demand

definitions.meaning: something outdated that nobody wants any more

explanation.definitionFit: An outdated custom or antique is something belonging to history and no longer in use.

clue.text: Captive with black eye going round to find the proprietor of vessel

indicators.note: the black eye goes round the captive, enclosing it

parts.note: a shiner is slang for a black eye
POW stands for prisoner of war

explanation.surface: A prisoner with a bruised eye searches for the ship's owner.
explanation.definitionFit: A shipowner is a person who owns a ship, the proprietor of a vessel.

clue.text: Positions on the line

explanation.definitionFit: Stations are assigned posts and also railway stops along a track.

clue.text: All-embracing connection capable of turning all ways

definitions.text: All-embracing connection capable of turning all ways

parts.note: universal means covering or embracing everything
a joint is a place where two parts connect

explanation.surface: A description of a flexible link that covers everything.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines the coupling, while its first two words build it; 'capable of turning all ways' adds the description.
explanation.definitionFit: A universal joint is a coupling between shafts that lets them turn at any angle.

clue.text: Man has US money for French wine first

indicators.note: first places the wine before the money

parts.note: vin is French for wine
a cent is a US coin

explanation.surface: A man trades dollars for a bottle of French wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Vincent is a man's first name, so it can stand for a man.

clue.text: After first half of July, Kelvin, early leader, appeared on television's record-player!

indicators.note: after places Kelvin behind the half of July
the first half of the word July means its first two letters

parts.note: K is the symbol for kelvin, a unit of temperature

indicators.note: the leader of early is its first letter

parts.note: the box is slang for television

explanation.surface: A man named Kelvin appears on TV in mid-July.
explanation.walkthrough: 'appeared on' is a link; 'early leader' gives E.
explanation.definitionFit: A jukebox is a coin-operated machine that plays records.

clue.text: Mountaineer's chopper?

parts.note: suggests a helicopter for climbers, but means a tool to cut steps in frozen slopes

explanation.definitionFit: An ice axe is the climber's tool for cutting footholds in ice, a chopper of a kind.

clue.text: I can hit fermenting wine

indicators.note: fermenting means bubbling and changing, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bubbling batch of wine gets struck.
explanation.definitionFit: Chianti is a red wine from Tuscany.

clue.text: Biblical character had one article in the bag

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: the article is placed inside the bag

parts.note: a sac is a bag-like part of a body
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A figure from the Bible kept a bit of writing in his bag.
explanation.definitionFit: Isaac, son of Abraham, is a figure in the Old Testament.

clue.text: Succeed, KO team maybe you, say, had been included

indicators.note: the letter goes inside the anagram, as included says
maybe suggests these letters could be arranged another way
say means the word is spoken and replaced by a letter of the same sound

parts.note: the word you sounds like the letter U

explanation.surface: A team is knocked out and someone wonders if you'd been in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges KO TEAM into MAKEOT; U goes in before the T.
explanation.definitionFit: To make out is an idiom meaning to manage or get on, so to succeed.

clue.text: Game no man played with the old king

indicators.note: played suggests the letters are moved about in a game

explanation.surface: A match no one played with an ancient ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: Agamemnon was the legendary king of Mycenae who led the Greeks at Troy.

clue.text: Do not allow lady to play this?

definitions.text: Do not allow lady to play this?

parts.note: to ban is to forbid or not allow
Jo is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A request that a woman be stopped playing an instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A banjo is a stringed instrument, so it is something one can play.

clue.text: And with this in France getting new rate -and the rest

parts.note: et is French for and
ce is French for this

indicators.note: new means the letters are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A French deal comes with a new exchange rate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges RATE into TERA. 'with' and 'getting' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Et cetera is Latin for and other things, meaning and the rest.

clue.text: Runs special editions

definitions.meaning: in cricket, runs not scored off the bat

explanation.definitionFit: Extras are cricket runs scored without the bat, and also additional newspaper editions.
